nodes.description: UE is in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state, not registered for 5GS services.
UE sends a REGISTRATION REQUEST message to the AMF.
UE has sent REGISTRATION REQUEST, started timer T3510, and is waiting for REGISTRATION ACCEPT or REGISTRATION REJECT from the AMF.
AMF receives the REGISTRATION REQUEST message from the UE.
AMF is processing the received REGISTRATION REQUEST message, potentially initiating common procedures like identification, authentication, and security.
AMF sends a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message to the UE.
AMF has sent REGISTRATION ACCEPT, requires acknowledgement, started timer T3550 awaiting REGISTRATION COMPLETE, and entered state 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED.
UE receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message from the AMF.
UE has successfully registered, entered state 5GMM-REGISTERED, and set 5GS update status to 5U1 UPDATED.
UE sends a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF, typically to acknowledge receipt of specific information in REGISTRATION ACCEPT.
AMF receives the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message from the UE.
AMF considers the UE successfully registered, having received REGISTRATION COMPLETE (if required) or completed processing REGISTRATION ACCEPT.
AMF sends a REGISTRATION REJECT message to the UE.
UE receives the REGISTRATION REJECT message from the AMF.
UE is processing a received REGISTRATION REJECT message or handling a T3510 timeout or lower layer failure.
Timer T3510 expires at the UE while waiting for a response to REGISTRATION REQUEST.
Timer T3550 expires at the AMF while waiting for REGISTRATION COMPLETE.
A failure is indicated by lower layers at either the UE or AMF during the registration procedure.
UE is in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED substate ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION, typically with timer T3346 or T3511 running, following a registration rejection or failure.
Timer T3511 expires at the UE.
Timer T3346 expires at the UE.

edges.description: Triggered when the UE in state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED initiates the registration procedure for initial registration (e.g., for 5GS services, emergency, SMS over NAS, mobility from GERAN/UTRAN, SNPN onboarding, disaster roaming, resuming normal services).
Triggered after UE sends REGISTRATION REQUEST and starts timer T3510.
Triggered when AMF receives REGISTRATION REQUEST and begins processing, potentially initiating common procedures.
Triggered when the AMF determines the initial registration request can be accepted.

Triggered if the sent REGISTRATION ACCEPT requires a REGISTRATION COMPLETE acknowledgement (e.g., contains 5G-GUTI, SOR, Operator-defined access category definitions, etc.); AMF starts timer T3550 and enters 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED state.
Triggered when the UE receives a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message from the AMF.
Triggered upon receiving REGISTRATION ACCEPT; UE resets registration attempt counter, enters 5GMM-REGISTERED state, and sets 5GS update status to 5U1 UPDATED.

Triggered if the received REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains specific IEs requiring acknowledgement (e.g., Network slicing subscription change, Configured NSSAI, NSSRG information, Alternative NSSAI, CAG information list, Operator-defined access category definitions, Negotiated PEIPS assistance information, UE radio capability ID, Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration, service-level-AA pending indication, SOR transparent container, On-demand NSSAI, S-NSSAI time/location validity info, NSAG info).
Triggered when the AMF receives the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message from the UE.
Triggered upon receiving REGISTRATION COMPLETE; AMF stops timer T3550 and transitions to 5GMM-REGISTERED state. Allocated 5G-GUTI, PEIPS info, UE radio capability ID, etc., are considered valid.
Triggered when the AMF determines the initial registration request cannot be accepted.
Triggered when the UE receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message from the AMF.
Triggered upon receiving REGISTRATION REJECT; UE proceeds to handle the rejection based on the included 5GMM cause value.

Triggered after processing rejection for specific REGISTRATION REJECT causes (e.g., #3, #6, #7, #11, #27, #31, #72-78, #80) leading to DEREGISTERED substates like NO-SUPI, PLMN-SEARCH, LIMITED-SERVICE. Also triggered upon T3510 timeout/Lower Layer Failure when registration attempt counter reaches 5; UE starts timer T3502 and enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED substate ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or PLMN-SEARCH (TS 24.501 5.5.1.2.7).
Triggered when timer T3510 expires at the UE before receiving REGISTRATION ACCEPT or REGISTRATION REJECT.
Triggered upon T3510 expiry; UE aborts the procedure, increments the registration attempt counter (if < 5), and potentially starts T3511 or enters a DEREGISTERED substate if counter reaches 5.
Triggered when timer T3550 expires at the AMF before receiving REGISTRATION COMPLETE (if expected).
Triggered on the first four expiries of T3550; AMF retransmits REGISTRATION ACCEPT, restarts T3550, and remains in 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED state.
Triggered when lower layers indicate a failure or release the NAS signalling connection at the UE before REGISTRATION ACCEPT/REJECT is received.

Triggered upon lower layer failure at UE before response; UE aborts the procedure, increments the registration attempt counter (if < 5), and potentially starts T3511 or enters a DEREGISTERED substate if counter reaches 5.
Triggered when a lower layer failure occurs at the AMF before REGISTRATION COMPLETE is received (if expected) and T3550 is running.
Triggered upon lower layer failure at AMF while awaiting REGISTRATION COMPLETE; AMF locally aborts the procedure and enters state 5GMM-REGISTERED.
Triggered if REGISTRATION ACCEPT does not require acknowledgement (T3550 not started); AMF enters registered state.
Triggered on the 5th expiry of T3550; AMF aborts the procedure and enters 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
Triggered after processing REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #22; UE starts timer T3346 and enters DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION substate.
Triggered after processing T3510 timeout or Lower Layer Failure if registration attempt counter < 5; UE starts timer T3511 and enters DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION substate.
Triggered when timer T3511 expires; UE restarts the registration procedure if still required.
Triggered when timer T3346 expires or is stopped; UE restarts the registration procedure if still required.
